OGN-002.name: Brazen Buccaneer
OGN-002.rulesText: As you play me, you may discard a card as an additional cost. If you do, reduce my cost by [2].
OGN-002.flavorText: "They called my crew 'scurvy dogs,' and I took that personally."

OGN-004.name: Cleave
OGN-004.flavorText: Nobody ever won a won without attacking.

OGN-005.name: Disintegrate
OGN-005.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. If this kills it, do this: draw 1.

OGN-006.name: Flame Chompers
OGN-006.rulesText: When you discard me, you may pay [C] to play me.

OGN-008.name: Get Excited!
OGN-008.rulesText:
[Action]
Discard 1. Deal its Energy cost as damage to a unit at a battlefield.

OGN-009.name: Hextech Ray
OGN-009.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield.

OGN-011.name: Magma Wurm
OGN-011.flavorText: A river of flame in an ocean of ice.

OGN-012.name: Noxus Hopeful
OGN-012.flavorText: First to the front, first to glory.

OGN-014.name: Sky Splitter
OGN-014.rulesText:
[Action]
This spell's Energy cost is reduced by the highest Might among units you control. Deal 5 to a unit at a battlefield.

OGN-016.name: Dangerous Duo
OGN-016.rulesText: [Legion] — When you play me, give a unit +2 [M] this turn.

OGN-017.name: Iron Ballista
OGN-017.rulesText:
This enters exhausted.
[E]: Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.
OGN-017.flavorText: "There's no way they can hit us at this dist—AUGH!"

OGN-018.name: Noxus Saboteur
OGN-018.rulesText: Your opponents' [Hidden] cards can't be revealed here.
OGN-018.flavorText: Nothing fails like a perfect plan.

OGN-019.name: Raging Soul
OGN-019.rulesText: If you've discarded a card this turn, I have [Assault] and [Ganking].

OGN-020.name: Scrapyard Champion
OGN-020.rulesText: [Legion] — When you play me, discard 2, then draw 2.
OGN-020.flavorText: "Last one standing" is a bit subjective.

OGN-021.name: Sun Disc
OGN-021.rulesText: [E]: [Legion] — The next unit you play this turn enters ready.

OGN-022.name: Thermo Beam
OGN-022.flavorText:
"Turn the limiter off, the beam is totally unstable."
—Common last words

OGN-023.name: Unlicensed Armory
OGN-023.rulesText: Discard 1, [E]: Choose a friendly unit. The next time it would die this turn, you may pay [C] to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.

OGN-024.name: Void Seeker
OGN-024.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 4 ot a unit at a battlefield. Draw 1.
OGN-024.flavorText:
"It's a good day for a hunt."
—Kai'Sa

OGN-025.name: Blind Fury
OGN-025.rulesText:
[Action]
Each opponent reveals the top card of their Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.

OGN-026.name: Brynhir Thundersong
OGN-026.rulesText: When you play me, opponents can't play cards this turn.

OGN-027.name: Darius, Trifarian
OGN-027.rulesText: When you play your second card in a turn, give me +2 [M] this turn and ready me.

OGN-028.name: Draven, Showboat
OGN-028.rulesText: My Might is increased by your points.

OGN-029.name: Falling Star
OGN-029.rulesText:
Do this twice:
Deal 3 to a unit.

OGN-030.name: Jinx, Demolitionist
OGN-030.flavorText: "I really need a new gun. But don't tell my other guns."

OGN-031.name: Raging Firebrand
OGN-031.rulesText: When you play me, the next spell you play this turn costs [5] less.

OGN-032.name: Ravenborn Tome
OGN-032.rulesText: [E]: The next spell you play this turn deals 1 Bonus Damage.
OGN-032.flavorText: The book is bound in flame-resistant materials, for obvious reasons.

OGN-033.name: Shakedown
OGN-033.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose an enemy unit. Deal 6 to it unless its controller has you draw 2.

OGN-034.name: Tryndamere, Barbarian
OGN-034.rulesText: When I conquer after an attack, if you assigned 5 or more excess damage to enemy units, you score 1 point.

OGN-035.name: Vayne, Hunter
OGN-035.rulesText:
[Assault 3]
If an opponent controls a battlefield, I enter ready.
When I conquer, you may pay [1] to return me to my owner's hand.

OGN-036.name: Vi, Destructive
OGN-036.rulesText:
[Ganking]
Recycle 1 from your trash: Give me +1 [M] this turn.

OGN-037.name: Immortal Phoenix
OGN-037.rulesText:
[Assault 2]
When you kill a unit with a spell, you may pay [1][C] to play me from your trash.
OGN-037.flavorText: The memory of every death fuels even brighter flames.

OGN-038.name: Kadregrin the Infernal
OGN-038.rulesText: When you play me, draw 1 for each of your [Mighty] units.

OGN-039.name: Kai'Sa, Survivor
OGN-039.flavorText: "I like it here. I just might stay."

OGN-041.name: Volibear, Furious
OGN-041.rulesText:
[Deflect 2]
When I attack, deal 5 damage split among any number of enemy units here.

OGN-043.name: Charm
OGN-043.flavorText:
"There's no harm in looking."
—Common last words

OGN-044.name: Clockwork Keeper
OGN-044.rulesText:
You may pay [C] as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, draw 1.
OGN-044.flavorText: It always goes back for seconds.

OGN-045.name: Defy
OGN-045.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Counter a spell that costs no more than [4] and no more than [A].

OGN-046.name: En Garde
OGN-046.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a friendly unit +1 [M] this turn, then an addtional +1 [M] this turn if it is the only unit you control there.
OGN-046.flavorText: "Is this supposed to be a challenge?" —Fiora

OGN-047.name: Find Your Center
OGN-047.rulesText:
[Action]
If an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, this costs [2] less.
Draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
OGN-047.flavorText: One does not wait for the perfect moment.

OGN-048.name: Meditation
OGN-048.rulesText:
[Reaction]
As an additional cost to play this, you may exhaust a friendly unit. If you do, draw 2. Otherwise, draw 1.

OGN-051.name: Solari Shieldbearer
OGN-051.rulesText: When you play me, stun a unit.

OGN-053.name: Stand United
OGN-053.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Buff a friendly unit. Buffs give an addtional +1 [M] to friendly units this turn.

OGN-054.name: Sunlit Guardian
OGN-054.flavorText: Nobody ever won a war without defending.

OGN-055.name: Wielder of Water
OGN-055.rulesText: While I'm attacking or defending alone, I have +2 [M].
OGN-055.flavorText: Each drop an ocean of possibilities.

OGN-056.name: Adaptatron
OGN-056.rulesText: When I conquer, you may kill a gear. If you do, buff me.

OGN-057.name: Block
OGN-057.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Give a unit [Shield 3] and [Tank] this turn.

OGN-058.name: Discipline
OGN-058.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a unit +2 [M] this turn. Draw 1.
OGN-058.flavorText: A blade is only as sharp as the one who wields it.

OGN-059.name: Eclipse Herald
OGN-059.rulesText: When you stun an enemy unit, ready me and give me +1 [M] this turn.
OGN-059.flavorText: An omen as terrifying as that which follows.

OGN-060.name: Mask of Foresight
OGN-060.rulesText: When a friendly unit attacks or defends alone, give it +1 [M] this turn.
OGN-060.flavorText: To know the future, you must first accept it.

OGN-061.name: Poro Herder
OGN-061.rulesText: When you play me, if you control a Poro, buff me and draw 1.
OGN-061.flavorText: A fluft is where you make it.

OGN-062.name: Reinforce
OGN-062.rulesText: Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may play a unit from among them. Its Energy cost is reduced by [5]. Then recycle the remaining cards.

OGN-063.name: Spirit's Refuge
OGN-063.rulesText:
When you play this, buff a friendly unit.
Friendly buffed units have [Deflect] if they didn't already.

OGN-065.name: Wizened Elder
OGN-065.rulesText: While I'm buffed, I have an addtional +1 [M].
OGN-065.flavorText: "I'm still fighting at my age. That should concern you more than it does."

OGN-066.name: Ahri, Alluring
OGN-066.rulesText: When I hold, you score 1 point.

OGN-067.name: Blitzcrank, Impassive
OGN-067.rulesText:
[Tank]
When you play me to a battlefield, you may move an enemy unit to here.
When I hold, return me to my owner's hand.

OGN-068.name: Caitlyn, Patrolling
OGN-068.rulesText:
I must be assigned combat damage last.
[E]: Deal damage equal to my Might to a unit at a battlefield. Use this ability only while I'm at a battlefield.

OGN-069.name: Last Stand
OGN-069.rulesText:
[Action]
Double a friendly unit's Might this turn. Give it [Temporary].

OGN-070.name: Mageseeker Warden
OGN-070.rulesText:
While I'm at a battlefield, opponents can only play units to their base.
While I'm at a battlefield, spells and abilities can't ready enemy units and gear.

OGN-071.name: Party Favors
OGN-071.rulesText: Each other player chooses Cards or Runes. For each player that chooses Cards, you and that player each draw 1. For each player that chooses Runes, you and that player each channel 1 rune exhausted.

OGN-072.name: Solari Shrine
OGN-072.rulesText: Whenever you kill a stunned enemy unit, you may exhaust this to draw 1.
OGN-072.flavorText: The names of the fallen are a lesson for our descendants.

OGN-073.name: Sona, Harmonious
OGN-073.rulesText: At the end of your turn, if I'm at a battlefield, ready up to 4 friendly runes.

OGN-076.name: Yasuo, Remorseful
OGN-076.rulesText: When I attack, deal damage equal to my Might to an enemy unit here.
OGN-076.flavorText: "Is a leaf's only purpose to fall?"

OGN-077.name: Zhonya's Hourglass
OGN-077.rulesText:
[Hidden]
If a friendly unit would die, kill this instead. Heal that unit, exhaust it, and recall it.

OGN-078.name: Lee Sin, Ascetic
OGN-078.rulesText:
[Shield]
[E]: Buff me.
I can have any number of buffs.
OGN-078.flavorText: "Let us see whose spirit is stronger."

OGN-079.name: Leona, Zealot
OGN-079.rulesText:
If an opponent's score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, I enter ready.
Stunned enemy units here have -8 [M], to a minimum of 1 [M].

OGN-080.name: Mystic Reversal
OGN-080.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Gain control of a spell. You may make new choices for it.
OGN-080.flavorText: Good mages borrow, great mages steal.

OGN-082.name: Whiteflame Protector
OGN-082.rulesText: When you play me, give a unit +8 [M] this turn.
OGN-082.flavorText: A dragon is capable of nobility equal to its r age.

OGN-084.name: Eager Apprentice
OGN-084.rulesText: While I'm at a battlefield, the Energy costs for spells you play is reduced by [1], to a minimum of [1].
OGN-084.flavorText: "As long as these thirty-seven things go right, it'll work every time!"

OGN-085.name: Falling Comet
OGN-085.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 6 to a unit at a battlefield.

OGN-087.name: Lecturing Yordle
OGN-087.flavorText: "... poisonous, but I didn't know that at the time. You see..."

OGN-088.name: Mega-Mech
OGN-088.flavorText:
Mech fights have two rules:
One—No cheating.
Two—Don't get caught cheating.

OGN-090.name: Orb of Regret
OGN-090.rulesText: [E]: Give a unit -1 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].
OGN-090.flavorText:
"There's beauty in even the most painful memories."
—Ahri

OGN-091.name: Pit Crew
OGN-091.rulesText: When you play a gear, ready me.

OGN-092.name: Riptide Rex
OGN-092.rulesText: When you play me, deal 6 to an enemy unit at a battlefield.

OGN-093.name: Smoke Screen
OGN-093.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a unit -4 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].
OGN-093.flavorText: "Well, well, well. What have we here?"

OGN-094.name: Sprite Call
OGN-094.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Play a ready 3 [M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary].

OGN-095.name: Stupefy
OGN-095.rulesText:
Give a unit -1 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].
Draw 1.
OGN-095.flavorText: It's easier to outsmart an opponent with a concussion.

OGN-096.name: Watchful Sentry
OGN-096.flavorText: He may never see home again. But because of him, that home still stands.

OGN-097.name: Blastcone Fae
OGN-097.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, give a unit -2 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].

OGN-098.name: Energy Conduit
OGN-098.flavorText: Whatever it does, it sure does a lot of it.

OGN-099.name: Garbage Grabber
OGN-099.flavorText: The constructs of the in-between feed on whatever gets lost in the portals—mostly keys and left socks.

OGN-100.name: Gemcraft Seer
OGN-100.flavorText: The light changes with every reflection.

OGN-101.name: Mushroom Pouch
OGN-101.rulesText: At the start of your Beginning Phase, if you control a facedown card at a battlefield, draw 1.

OGN-102.name: Portal Rescue
OGN-102.rulesText: Banish a friendly unit, then its owner plays it to their base, ignoring its cost.
OGN-102.flavorText:
"Where do the portals go? You know, I've never asked."
—Norra

OGN-103.name: Ravenbloom Student
OGN-103.rulesText: When you play a spell, give me +1 [M] this turn.
OGN-103.flavorText: A little knowledge is a dagnerous thing. A lot of knowledge is awesome

OGN-104.name: Retreat
OGN-104.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Return a friendly unit to its owner's hand. Its owner channels 1 rune exhausted.

OGN-105.name: Singularity
OGN-105.rulesText: Deal 6 to each of up to two units.

OGN-106.name: Sprite Mother
OGN-106.rulesText: When you play me, play a ready 3 [M] Sprite unit token with [Temporary] here.

OGN-107.name: Ava Achiever
OGN-107.rulesText: When I attack, you may pay [C] to play a card with [Hidden] from your hand, ignoring its cost. If itʼs a unit, play it here.

OGN-108.name: Convergent Mutation
OGN-108.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a friendly unit. This turn, increase its Might to the Might of another friendly unit.
OGN-108.flavorText: "I don't know. I think it's kind of cute."

OGN-109.name: Dr. Mundo, Expert
OGN-109.rulesText:
My Might is increased by the number of cards in your trash.
At the start of your Beginning Phase, recycle 3 from your trash.

OGN-110.name: Ekko, Recurrent
OGN-110.rulesText: [Accelerate] [Deathknell] — Recycle me to ready your runes.

OGN-111.name: Heimerdinger, Inventor
OGN-111.rulesText: I have all [E] abilities of all friendly legends, units, and gear.

OGN-112.name: Kai'Sa, Evolutionary
OGN-112.rulesText:
[Ganking]
When I conquer, you may play a spell from your trash with Energy cost less than your points without paying its Energy cost. Then recycle it.

OGN-113.name: Malzahar, Fanatic
OGN-113.rulesText: Kill a friendly unit or gear, [E]: [Action] — [Add] [A][A].

OGN-114.name: Progress Day
OGN-114.flavorText: See the dreams of a thousand tomorrows, and at such a low price!

OGN-115.name: Promising Future
OGN-115.rulesText: Each player looks at the top 5 cards of their Main Deck, banishes one of them, then recycles the rest. Starting with the next player, each player plays those cards, ignoring Energy costs.

OGN-116.name: Thousand-Tailed Watcher
OGN-116.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When you play me, give enemy units -3 [M] htis turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].
OGN-116.flavorText: You will know when you've pushed the wilds too far.

OGN-117.name: Viktor, Innovator
OGN-117.rulesText: When you play a card on an opponent's turn , play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token in your base.

OGN-118.name: Wraith of Echoes
OGN-118.rulesText: The first time another friendly unit dies each turn, draw 1.
OGN-118.flavorText: His friends are with him in spirit.

OGN-119.name: Ahri, Inquisitive
OGN-119.rulesText: When I attack or defend, give an enemy unit here -2 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].

OGN-121.name: Teemo, Strategist
OGN-121.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When I defend, choose an enemy unit here and reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to that unit for each card with [Hidden] revealed this way, then recycle the revealed cards.

OGN-122.name: Time Warp
OGN-122.rulesText: Take a turn after this one. Banish this.
OGN-122.flavorText:
"Fool me once... and I'll just rewind."
—Ekko

OGN-123.name: Unchecked Power
OGN-123.rulesText: Exhaust all friendly units, then deal 12 to all units at battlefields.

OGN-125.name: Bilgewater Bully
OGN-125.flavorText: Places to go, people to gank.

OGN-127.name: Cannon Barrage
OGN-127.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Deal 2 to all enemy units in combat.
OGN-127.flavorText: If you've got enough guns, you don't need to aim.

OGN-128.name: Challenge
OGN-128.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose a friendly unit and an enemy unit. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.
OGN-128.flavorText: "He started it when he hit me back!"

OGN-129.name: Confront
OGN-129.rulesText:
[Action]
Units you play this turn enter ready.
Draw 1.
OGN-129.flavorText: Now is the only moment that matters.

OGN-130.name: Crackshot Corsair
OGN-130.rulesText: When I attack, deal 1 to an enemy unit here.

OGN-131.name: Dune Drake
OGN-131.rulesText: When I attack, give me +2 [M] this turn if there is a ready enemy unit here.
OGN-131.flavorText: Dragons hunt not just for food, but for the thrill of it.

OGN-132.name: First Mate
OGN-132.rulesText: When you play me, ready another unit.
OGN-132.flavorText: "It's a boarding party! Try to have some fun with it."

OGN-133.name: Flurry of Blades
OGN-133.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Deal 1 to all units at battlefields.

OGN-134.name: Mobilize
OGN-134.rulesText: Channel 1 rune exhausted. If you can't, draw 1.
OGN-134.flavorText: The sound of trumpets is the first blow struck in battle.

OGN-136.name: Pit Rookie
OGN-136.rulesText: When you play me, buff another friendly unit.

OGN-137.name: Stormclaw Ursine
OGN-137.rulesText:
[Tank]
When you play me, channel 1 rune exhausted.
OGN-137.flavorText:
"The Ursine speak for man, and the wild responds."
—Volibear

OGN-138.name: Catalyst of Aeons
OGN-138.rulesText: Channel 2 runes exhausted. If you couldn't channel 2 runes this way, draw 1.
OGN-138.flavorText: Ages of strife, crystallized into eternity.

OGN-139.name: Cithria of Cloudfield
OGN-139.rulesText: When you play another unit, buff me.

OGN-140.name: Herald of Scales
OGN-140.rulesText: Your Dragons' Energy costs are reduced by [2], to a minimum of [1].
OGN-140.flavorText: The language of dragons is a magic of its own.

OGN-141.name: Kinkou Monk
OGN-141.rulesText: When you play me, buff up to two other friendly units.
OGN-141.flavorText: A master teaches the same lesson again and again, and learns something new each time.

OGN-142.name: Mountain Drake
OGN-142.flavorText: After centuries spent trying to understand dragon behavior, researchers can agree on one thing: If you're seeing that behavior up close... run.

OGN-143.name: Pirate's Haven
OGN-143.rulesText: When you ready a friendly unit, give it +1 [M] this turn.
OGN-143.flavorText: It's the best place in the world, until you run out of coin.

OGN-144.name: Spoils of War
OGN-144.rulesText:
[Reaction]
If an enemy unit has died this turn, this costs [2] less.
Draw 2.

OGN-145.name: Unyielding Spirit
OGN-145.rulesText: Prevent all damage that would be dealt this turn by spells and abilities.
OGN-145.flavorText: Battles are won in the heart before they are won on the field.

OGN-146.name: Wallop
OGN-146.rulesText:
[Action]
As you play this, you may spend a buff as an additional cost. If you do, ignore this spell's cost.
OGN-146.flavorText: If smashing doesn't work, just keep smashing.

OGN-147.name: Wildclaw Shaman
OGN-147.rulesText: When you play me, you may spend a buff to buff me and ready me.
OGN-147.flavorText: To channel nature's fury, a shaman must endure it.

OGN-148.name: Anivia, Primal
OGN-148.rulesText: When I attack, deal 3 to all enemy units here.

OGN-149.name: Carnivorous Snapvine
OGN-149.rulesText: When you play me, choose an enemy unit at a battlefield. We deal damage equal to our Mights to each other.
OGN-149.flavorText: Gardening is usually a very relaxing hobby.

OGN-150.name: Kraken Hunter
OGN-150.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
[Assault]
As you play me, you may spend any number of buffs as an additional cost. Reduce my cost by [C] for each buff you spend.

OGN-151.name: Lee Sin, Centered
OGN-151.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
Other buffed friendly units at my battlefield have +2 [M].

OGN-152.name: Mistfall
OGN-152.rulesText: When you buff a friendly unit, you may pay [C] and exhaust this to ready it.
OGN-152.flavorText: Thousands of thwarted dreams, ready to be lifted anews.

OGN-153.name: Overt Operation
OGN-153.rulesText:
[Action]
For each friendly unit, you may spend its buff to ready it. Then buff all friendly units.
OGN-153.flavorText: "We can go deep undercover, sneak in through the back, and end this quietly. Or..."

OGN-154.name: Primal Strength
OGN-154.flavorText: There is savagery inside us all.

OGN-155.name: Qiyana, Victorious
OGN-155.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When I conquer, draw 1 or channel 1 rune exhausted.
OGN-155.flavorText: "Line them up. I will bend their knees."

OGN-156.name: Sabotage
OGN-156.rulesText: Choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a non-unit card from it, and recycle that card.
OGN-156.flavorText: Sometimes it takes dirty tricks to ensure a fair fight.

OGN-157.name: Udyr, Wildman
OGN-157.rulesText:
Spend my buff: Choose one you've not chosen this turn —
• Deal 2 to a unit at a battlefield.
• Stun a unit at a battlefield.
• Ready me.
• Give me [Ganking] this turn.

OGN-158.name: Volibear, Imposing
OGN-158.rulesText:
[Shield 3]
[Tank]
When an opponent moves to a battlefield other than mine, draw 1.
OGN-158.flavorText: "Gods do not beg. We take what is ours!"

OGN-159.name: Warwick, Hunter
OGN-159.rulesText:
I enter ready.
When I attack, kill all damaged enemy units here.
OGN-159.flavorText: "The blood you spilled calls to me."

OGN-160.name: Dazzling Aurora
OGN-160.rulesText: At the end of your turn, reveal cards from the top of your Main Deck until you reveal a unit and banish it. Play it, ignoring its cost, and recycle the rest.
OGN-160.flavorText: The omens offer much to those who dare to see them.

OGN-161.name: Deadbloom Predator
OGN-161.rulesText:
[Deflect]
You may play me to an occupied enemy battlefield.
OGN-161.flavorText: The souls of those who died unfulfilled coalesce into a form to sate those hungers.

OGN-162.name: Miss Fortune, Captain
OGN-162.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
[Ganking]
The first time I move each turn, you may ready something else that's exhausted.

OGN-163.name: Seal of Strength
OGN-163.flavorText: "Momma always said I had her temper."

OGN-164.name: Sett, Brawler
OGN-164.rulesText:
When I'm played and when I conquer, buff me.
Spend my buff: Give me +4 [M] this turn.

OGN-165.name: Cemetery Attendant
OGN-165.rulesText: When you play me, return a unit from your trash to your hand.
OGN-165.flavorText: "Good boy! Now, where's the rest of 'em?"

OGN-167.name: Ember Monk
OGN-167.rulesText: When you play a card from [Hidden], give me +2 [M] this turn.
OGN-167.flavorText: A flame bright enough to cast many shadows.

OGN-168.name: Fight or Flight
OGN-168.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Move a unit from a battlefield to its base.

OGN-169.name: Gust
OGN-169.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Return a unit at a battlefield with 3 [M] or less to its owner's hand.

OGN-170.name: Morbid Return
OGN-170.rulesText:
[Action]
Return a unit from your trash to your hand.
OGN-170.flavorText:
"Soon, this long cruel night will end. But not yet."
—Viego

OGN-171.name: Mystic Poro
OGN-171.flavorText: Forecast: Sunny, with a chance of snax.

OGN-172.name: Rebuke
OGN-172.rulesText:
[Action]
Return a unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.

OGN-173.name: Ride the Wind
OGN-173.rulesText:
[Action]
Move a friendly unit and ready it.
OGN-173.flavorText:
"Follow the wind, but watch your back."
—Yasuo

OGN-174.name: Sai Scout
OGN-174.rulesText:
[Vision]
You may play me to an open battlefield.

OGN-175.name: Shipyard Skulker
OGN-175.flavorText: Few people laughed when she claimed she was a "dock pirate"—or at least, few remained.

OGN-176.name: Sneaky Deckhand
OGN-176.rulesText: You may play me to an open battlefield.
OGN-176.flavorText:
"I like to think of her as a pre-boarding party."
—Miss Fortune

OGN-177.name: Stealthy Pursuer
OGN-177.rulesText: When a friendly unit moves from my location, I may be moved with it.
OGN-177.flavorText: "Anywhere you can go, I can go better."

OGN-178.name: Undercover Agent
OGN-178.flavorText: Even he no longer knew which side he worked for.

OGN-179.name: Acceptable Losses
OGN-179.rulesText: Each player kills one of their gear.

OGN-180.name: Fading Memories
OGN-180.rulesText: Give a unit at a battlefield or a gear [Temporary].

OGN-181.name: Pack of Wonders
OGN-181.rulesText: [E]: Return another friendly gear, unit, or facedown card to its owner's hand.
OGN-181.flavorText:
"I know I put it in here somewhere..."
—Teemo

OGN-182.name: Scrapheap
OGN-182.rulesText: When this is played, discarded, or killed, draw 1.
OGN-182.flavorText: The parts that make it to the heap are the ones that DIDN'T blow up.

OGN-183.name: Stacked Deck
OGN-183.rulesText:
[Action]
Look at the top 3 card of your Main Deck. Put 1 into your hand and recycle the rest.

OGN-184.name: The Syren
OGN-184.rulesText: [1], [E]: Move a friendly unit at a battlefield to its base.
OGN-184.flavorText: Without a ship, a pirate's just another common criminal.

OGN-185.name: Traveling Merchant
OGN-185.rulesText: When I move, discard 1, then draw 1.

OGN-186.name: Treasure Trove
OGN-186.rulesText:
When this leaves the board, draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
[C], [E]: Kill this.

OGN-187.name: Whirlwind
OGN-187.rulesText: Starting with the next player, each player may return a unit to its owner's hand.

OGN-188.name: Zaunite Bouncer
OGN-188.rulesText: When you play me, return another unit at a battlefield to its owner's hand.
OGN-188.flavorText: If he had things his way, NOBODY would get in."

OGN-189.name: Kayn, Unleashed
OGN-189.rulesText:
[Ganking]
If I have moved twice this turn, I don't take damage.
OGN-189.flavorText: "I will survive eternity. They will die today."

OGN-190.name: Kog'Maw, Caustic
OGN-190.rulesText: [Deathknell] — Deal 4 to all units at my battlefield.

OGN-191.name: Maddened Marauder
OGN-191.rulesText:
[Tank]
When you play me, move a unit from a battlefield to its base.
OGN-191.flavorText: They know no fear. Nor much of anything else, really.

OGN-192.name: Mindsplitter
OGN-192.rulesText: When you play me, choose an opponent. They reveal their hand. Choose a card from it, and they discard that card.
OGN-192.flavorText: Its victims go mad deciding which half to run from first.

OGN-193.name: Miss Fortune, Buccaneer
OGN-193.rulesText:
You may play me to an open battlefield.
Friendly units may be played to open battlefields.

OGN-194.name: Nocturne, Horrifying
OGN-194.rulesText:
[Ganking]
As you look at or reveal me from the top of your deck, you may banish me. If you do, you may play me for [A].

OGN-195.name: Rhasa the Sunderer
OGN-195.rulesText: I cost [1] less for each card in your trash.
OGN-195.flavorText: It feeds well on death, but better on madness.

OGN-196.name: Soul Gorger
OGN-196.rulesText: When you play me, you may play a unit from your trash, ignoring its Energy cost.

OGN-197.name: Teemo, Scout
OGN-197.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, give me +3 [M] this turn.

OGN-198.name: The Harrowing
OGN-198.rulesText: Play a unit from your trash, ignoring its Energy cost.

OGN-199.name: Tideturner
OGN-199.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, you may choose a unit you control at another location. Move me to its location and it to my original location.

OGN-200.name: Twisted Fate, Gambler
OGN-200.rulesText:
When I attack, reveal the top rune of your rune deck, then recycle it. Do one of the following based on its domain:
[R] - Deal 2 to an enemy unit here and 1 to all other enemy units here.
[B] - Draw 1.
[Y] - Stun an enemy unit.

OGN-201.name: Invert Timelines
OGN-201.rulesText: Each player discards their hand, then draws 4.
OGN-201.flavorText:
"Good a time as any to act reckless."
—Ekko

OGN-202.name: Jinx, Rebel
OGN-202.rulesText: When you discard one or more cards, ready me and give me +1 [M] this turn.
OGN-202.flavorText: "Rules are made to be broken. Like buildings! Or people!"

OGN-203.name: Possession
OGN-203.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose an enemy unit at a battlefield. Take control of it and recall it.
OGN-203.flavorText: Some have a change of heart. Others need you to change it for them.

OGN-205.name: Yasuo, Windrider
OGN-205.rulesText:
[Ganking]
The third time I move in a turn, you score 1 point.
OGN-205.flavorText: "I will follow the path until the end."

OGN-206.name: Back to Back
OGN-206.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give two friendly units each +2 [M] this turn.

OGN-207.name: Call to Glory
OGN-207.rulesText:
[Reactton]
As you play this, you may spend a buff as an addtional cost. If you do, ignore this spell's cost.

OGN-208.name: Cruel Patron
OGN-208.rulesText: As an additional cost to play me, kill a friendly unit.
OGN-208.flavorText: Fealty is a duty, not a choice.

OGN-209.name: Cull the Weak
OGN-209.rulesText: Each player kills one of their units.
OGN-209.flavorText: What good is having a plank if nobody ever walks it?

OGN-211.name: Faithful Manufactor
OGN-211.rulesText: When you play me, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token here.
OGN-211.flavorText: Hard work is its own reward.

OGN-212.name: Forge of the Future
OGN-212.rulesText:
When you play this, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token at your base.
Kill this: Recycle up to 4 cards from trashes.
OGN-212.flavorText: "What do we make? Beats me, but we do it better than anyone else."

OGN-213.name: Hidden Blade
OGN-213.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Kill a unit at a battlefield. Its controller draws 2.
OGN-213.flavorText: Not every Noxian decree is read aloud.

OGN-215.name: Petty Officer
OGN-215.flavorText: Cross him and you'll learn just how petty he can be.

OGN-217.name: Trifarian Gloryseeker
OGN-217.rulesText: [Legion] — When you play me, buff me.
OGN-217.flavorText: War demands your life but offers immortality.

OGN-218.name: Vanguard Captain
OGN-218.rulesText: [Legion] — When you play me, play two 1 [M] Recruit unit tokens here.

OGN-219.name: Vanguard Sergeant
OGN-219.flavorText: He knew his orders: hold the line, or there would be nothing left to hold.

OGN-220.name: Facebreaker
OGN-220.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Stun a friendly unit and an enemy unit at the same battlefield.

OGN-221.name: Imperial Decree
OGN-221.rulesText:
[Action]
When any unit takes damage this turn, kill it.

OGN-222.name: Noxian Drummer
OGN-222.rulesText: When I move to a battlefield, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token here.
OGN-222.flavorText: Even the Legion's musicians are hard to beat.

OGN-223.name: Peak Guardian
OGN-223.rulesText: When you play me, buff me. Then, if I am at a battlefield, buff all other friendly units there.
OGN-223.flavorText: Mount Targon's blessing is bestowed upon those who have proven they are strong enough without it.

OGN-224.name: Salvage
OGN-224.rulesText:
[Action]
You may kill up to one gear. Draw 1.
OGN-224.flavorText: One person's treasure is another one's trash.

OGN-225.name: Solari Chief
OGN-225.rulesText: When you play me, choose an enemy unit. If it is stunned, kill it. Otherwise, stun it.
OGN-225.flavorText: The sun has many rays, each tasked with driving out the darkness.

OGN-226.name: Spectral Matron
OGN-226.rulesText: When you play me, you may play a unit costing no more than [3] and no more than [A] from your trash, ignoring its cost.

OGN-227.name: Symbol of the Solari
OGN-227.rulesText: If a combat where you are the attacker ends in a tie that would recall any of your units, recall all units at that battlefield instead.
OGN-227.flavorText:
"Next time, try to leave a dent!"
—Leona

OGN-228.name: Vanguard Helm
OGN-228.rulesText: When a buffed friendly unit dies, buff another friendly unit.
OGN-228.flavorText: Vanguard soliders share both a helm and a vision.

OGN-229.name: Vengeance
OGN-229.flavorText: A brief moment of turmoil—then peace.

OGN-230.name: Albus Ferros
OGN-230.rulesText: When you play me, spend any number of buffs. For each buff spent, channel 1 rune exhausted.
OGN-230.flavorText: In Piltover, the best way to become a great inventor is to find a great investor.

OGN-231.name: Commander Ledros
OGN-231.rulesText:
As you play me, you may kill any number of friendly units as an additional cost. Reduce my cost by [C] for each killed this way.
[Deflect]
[Ganking]

OGN-233.name: Grand Strategem
OGN-233.flavorText: You need not understand the plan—only believe in it.

OGN-234.name: Harnessed Dragon
OGN-234.rulesText: When you play me, kill an enemy unit.
OGN-234.flavorText: What bends a dragon's will is not strength, but sense of purpose.

OGN-235.name: Karma, Channeler
OGN-235.rulesText:
[Vision]
When you recycle one or more cards to your Main Deck, buff a friendly unit.

OGN-236.name: Karthus, Eternal
OGN-236.rulesText: Your [Deathknell] effects trigger an additional time.
OGN-236.flavorText: "We all have a place among the divine. We have only to accept it."

OGN-237.name: King's Edict
OGN-237.rulesText: Starting with the next player, each other player chooses a unit you don't control that hasn't been chosen for this spell. Kill those units.
OGN-237.flavorText: Ruling is about making the hard choices. Serving is about living with the consequences.

OGN-238.name: Leona, Determined
OGN-238.rulesText:
[Shield]
When I attack, stun an enemy unit here.

OGN-239.name: Machine Evangel
OGN-239.rulesText: [Deathknell] — Play three 1 [M] Recruit unit tokens into your base.
OGN-239.flavorText: The future is built by those who never see it.

OGN-240.name: Sett, Kingpin
OGN-240.rulesText:
[Tank]
I get +1 [M] for each buffed friendly unit at my battlefield.
OGN-240.flavorText: "Bein' the boss is a lot better than not bein' the boss."

OGN-242.name: Baited Hook
OGN-242.rulesText: [1][C], [E]: Kill a friendly unit. Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may banish a unit from among them that has Might up to 1 more than the killed unit and play it, ignoring its cost. Then recycle the rest.
OGN-242.flavorText: There's always a bigger fish—sometimes a MUCH bigger fish.

OGN-243.name: Darius, Executioner
OGN-243.rulesText:
[Legion] — When you play me, ready me.
Other friendly units have +1 [M] here.

OGN-244.name: Divine Judgement
OGN-244.rulesText: Each player chooses 2 units, 2 gear, 2 runes, and 2 cards in their hands. Recycle the rest.

OGN-246.name: Viktor, Leader
OGN-246.rulesText: When another non-Recruit unit you control dies, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token into your base.

OGN-248.name: Icathian Rain
OGN-248.rulesText:
Do this 6 times:
Deal 2 to a unit.

OGN-249.name: Volibear, Relentless Storm
OGN-249.rulesText: When you play a [Mighty] unit,l you may exhaust me to channel 1 rune exhausted.

OGN-250.name: Stormbringer
OGN-250.rulesText: Choose a friendly unit in your base. Deal damage equal to its Might to all enemy units at a battlefield, then move your unit there.

OGN-251.name: Jinx, Loose Cannon
OGN-251.rulesText: At start of your Beginning Phase, draw 1 if you have one or fewer cards in your hand.

OGN-252.name: Super Mega Death Rocket!
OGN-252.rulesText:
Deal 5 to a unit.
When you conquer, you may discard 1 to return this from your trash to your hand.

OGN-254.name: Noxian Guillotine
OGN-254.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose a unit. Kill it the next time it takes damage this turn.
[Legion] — Kill it now instead.

OGN-255.name: Ahri, Nine-Tailed Fox
OGN-255.rulesText: When an enemy unit attacks a battlefield you control, give it -1 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].

OGN-256.name: Fox-Fire
OGN-256.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Action]
Kill any number of units at a battlefield with total Might 4 or less.

OGN-258.name: Dragon's Rage
OGN-258.rulesText: Move an enemy unit. Then do this: Choose another enemy unit at its destination. They deal damage equal to their Mights to each other.

OGN-259.name: Yasuo, Unforgiven
OGN-259.rulesText: [2], [E]: Move a friendly unit to or from its base.

OGN-260.name: Last Breath
OGN-260.rulesText:
[Action]
Ready a friendly unit. It deals damage equal to its Might to an enemy unit at a battlefield.

OGN-261.name: Leona, Radiant Dawn
OGN-261.rulesText: When you stun one or more enemy units, buff a friendly unit.

OGN-262.name: Zenith Blade
OGN-262.rulesText:
[Action]
Stun an enemy unit at a battlefield. You may move a friendly unit to that enemy unit's battlefield.

OGN-263.name: Teemo, Swift Scout
OGN-263.rulesText:
You may pay [1] to hide a card with [Hidden] instead of [A].
[1], [E]: Put a Teemo unit you own into your hand from your Champion Zone or the board.

OGN-264.name: Guerilla Warfare
OGN-264.rulesText: Return up to two cards with [Hidden] from your trash to your hand. You can hide ignoring costs this turn.

OGN-266.name: Siphon Power
OGN-266.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a battlefield. Give friendly units there +1 [M] this turn and enemy units there -1 [M] this turn, to a minimum of 1 [M].

OGN-268.name: Bullet Time
OGN-268.rulesText:
[Action]
Pay any amount of [A] to deal that much damage to all enemy units at a battlefield.

OGN-269.name: Sett, the Boss
OGN-269.rulesText:
If a buffed unit you control would die, you may pay [C], exhaust me, and spend its buff to heal it, exhaust it, and recall it instead.
When you conquer, ready me.

OGN-270.name: Showstopper
OGN-270.rulesText: Buff a friendly unit in your base, then move it to a battlefield.

OGN-271.name: Recruit
OGN-271.flavorText: "To strike against any of us is to strike against all of us!"

OGN-272.name: Recruit
OGN-272.flavorText: "Few earn the right to call themselves Trifarian."

OGN-274.name: Sprite
OGN-274.flavorText: Dreams rarely linger, but the dreamer is still changed.

OGN-275.name: Altar to Unity
OGN-275.rulesText: When you hold here, play a 1 [M] Recruit unit token in your base.

OGN-276.name: Aspirant's Climb
OGN-276.rulesText: Increase the points needed to win the game by 1.

OGN-277.name: Back-Alley Bar
OGN-277.rulesText: When a unit moves from here, give it +1 [M] this turn.

OGN-278.name: Bandle Tree
OGN-278.rulesText: You may hide an additional card here.

OGN-279.name: Fortified Position
OGN-279.rulesText: When you defend here, choose a unit. It gains [Shield 2] this combat.

OGN-281.name: Hallowed Tomb
OGN-281.rulesText: When you hold here, you may return your Chosen Champion from your trash to your Champion Zone if it is empty.

OGN-282.name: Monastery of Hirana
OGN-282.rulesText: When you conquer here, you may spend a buff to draw 1.

OGN-283.name: Navori Fighting Pit
OGN-283.rulesText: When you hold here, buff a unit here.

OGN-284.name: Obelisk of Power
OGN-284.rulesText: At the start of each player's first Beginning Phase, that player channels 1 rune.

OGN-285.name: Reaver's Row
OGN-285.rulesText: When you defend here, you may move a friendly unit here to base.

OGN-286.name: Reckoner's Arena
OGN-286.rulesText: When you hold here, activate the conquer effects of units here.

OGN-287.name: Sigil of the Storm
OGN-287.rulesText: When you conquer here, you must recycle one of your runes.

OGN-288.name: Startipped Peak
OGN-288.rulesText: When you hold here, you may channel 1 rune exhausted.

OGN-289.name: Targon's Peak
OGN-289.rulesText: When you conquer here, ready up to 2 runes at the end of this turn.

OGN-290.name: The Arena's Greatest
OGN-290.rulesText: At the start of each player's first Beginning Phase, that player gains 1 point.

OGN-291.name: The Candlelit Sanctum
OGN-291.rulesText: When you conquer here, look at the top two cards of your Main Deck. You may recycle one or both of them. Put those you don't back in any order.

OGN-292.name: The Dreaming Tree
OGN-292.rulesText: When a player chooses a friendly unit here with a spell for the first time each turn, they draw 1.

OGN-293.name: The Grand Plaza
OGN-293.rulesText: When you hold here, if you have 7+ units here, you win the game.

OGN-295.name: Vilemaw's Lair
OGN-295.rulesText: Units can't move from here to base.

OGN-296.name: Void Gate
OGN-296.rulesText: Spells and abilities deal 1 Bonus Damage to units here.

OGN-298.name: Zaun Warrens
OGN-298.rulesText: When you conquer here, discard 1, then draw 1.
